_comment: The locked 2.5D anime register: the exact prompt/model that produced assets/register-anime-25d.png, kept in-repo so the examples run standalone. See characters/yuri.yaml for the prompt parts the service assembles at runtime.
prompt: Vertical 2:3 portrait. Style: high-end 2.5D semi-realistic anime character art — large glossy anime eyes with intricate iris detail and bright catchlights, soft airbrushed cel shading on flawless skin with a subtle subsurface glow, hair rendered in fine individual strands, dreamy soft lighting, creamy bokeh background. Halfway between anime illustration and a polished 3D render, like a premium collectible character card. NOT photorealistic, NOT flat cartoon. Subject: a breathtakingly cute young woman with fluffy dark cat ears and a long elegant dark cat tail — fur only on the ears and tail, matching her long flowing dark hair with an iridescent magenta-and-cyan sheen. Large warm expressive eyes, gentle inviting smile. She wears sleek alluring black techwear: a cropped halter top baring her shoulders and midriff, snug shorts with a thigh strap, a slim luminous choker, one thin glowing magenta accent stripe (#ff2bd6) along a detached sleeve, and a faint elegant light-trace glowing behind one ear. Scene: she sits relaxed on the ledge of a rain-slick rooftop at night, one knee drawn up, head tilted slightly, looking at the viewer. Behind her a cyberpunk megacity dissolves into soft creamy bokeh of magenta (#ff2bd6) and cyan (#00e5ff) neon with drifting holographic haze and gentle volumetric glow. Mood: cute, intimate, inviting. No nudity.
